account:
Today I have heard repeated, vague reports of a 'bridge or port change at the bakery,' but I have not witnessed such a change or received a clear explanation. Several townsfolk repeat essentially the same wording, which is not independent confirmation. My neighbour says they saw Builder give the baker a lantern and planks last night, but did not know their purpose and had not witnessed any bridge or port change. I asked the baker for clarification before lunch, but received no answer that I heard. The materials might be for lighting or building work, but I cannot establish their purpose or connect them to the rumours. There is an approved lighting inspection at 18:00; any connection is also unconfirmed.

I attended the mill for the morning grain inspection but could not locate the miller. My neighbour had not seen the miller either. Grain stocks therefore still require a follow-up report; this alone does not establish that anything is wrong. I asked the secretary to record the follow-up and deliver a request to the mill. The secretary needs a writable book, which I said I would arrange on returning at 16:30. No council correspondence was delivered today, and the secretary reported no further morning concerns.

I have now arrived at the neighbour's dockside cottage for our 15:00 tea and asked whether they learned anything more from the baker. I am waiting for their reply. For now, the unusual news remains an unexplained rumour, alongside a firsthand report of a lantern-and-planks delivery.
